t: Lesson 7, Plugins. Your instructor is Patrick Diamitani.
A plugin gives you a ready-made toolkit for your job in one install.
A plugin is a package that can hold four things.
Skills that teach Claude a workflow, connectors to your outside tools,
agents specialists Claude can delegate to,
and hooks small scripts that run at set moments.
Installing takes a minute.
Open Customize in the sidebar and choose Plugins.
Browse Discover, pick one, and click Install.
Then open its connectors tab and connect each tool.
There are plugins for most roles.
For business teams, like sales, marketing, and legal.
And for technical teams, like data, engineering, and design.
Install the one that matches your job,
and you start with a team's worth of know-how.
Plugins scale across teams.
Admins can require a plugin, so everyone has it.
Teams can share their own plugins from a Git repository,
and only install plugins from sources you trust.
Quick recap. A plugin bundles skills, connectors, and agents
into one install for your role.
Your mission, install one plugin for your role,
and run one of its skills on a real task.
You've got a toolkit.
Next lesson, agents, delegate the busy work.
